LanguageData.LP_RedHawkLeague.label: Red Hawk Trade League
LanguageData.LP_RedHawkLeague.description: A trade league spanning Faerûn's major ports, whose banner shows a red hawk holding a gold coin. Red Hawk asks no questions about origins and only honors contracts: slaves, dragon scales, mithril, soul coins of the Abyss, even pact scrolls signed by otherworldly patrons themselves; anything can be bought at the right price.\n\nThe league holds no prejudice against liches, mind flayers or demon pactmakers; to them, these are just bigger clients.
LanguageData.LP_RedHawkLeague.ideoDescription: Every deal must be signed, and every signature must be honored.
